decisions.quote: Curioni et al. (2022; https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2022.0128) recently found in a series of experiments that humans demonstrated a consistent preference to perform a box-clearing task with a partner, rather than alone, despite this way of completing the task being more costly. Here we will assess the replicability of this effect in an experiment modeled after Experiment 1 in their paper.
decisions.reason: The primary source confirms the dependent record type (replication) and target identity (Curioni et al., 2022, DOI 10.1098/rspb.2022.0128, Experiment 1), but the text of 10.17605/osf.io/evdp5 is a prospective OSF preregistration ('Registration prior to creation of data') that describes only planned methods and predictions without any data or results. The shipped 'failed' outcome and quote come from a later completed preprint not present in the primary source, leaving the replication outcome undeterminable from the primary text.
